purpose: 标定现状核对：区分已完成的内参标定与仍未完成的 IPM 外参 / EKF 协方差 / AprilTag 布设。

front_camera_intrinsics.note: This is the front mono UVC camera at 1280x720. It is not the Gemini depth camera and not the arm eye-in-hand stereo.

gemini_depth_intrinsics.note: Factory calibration; no manual depth calibration was performed. If the stream resolution changes, use the CameraInfo published at that resolution.

front_camera_extrinsics.needed_for: IPM / pure vision line following (height, pitch, roll, x, y)
front_camera_extrinsics.acceptance: 5-point ground calibration, reprojection RMS < 1.5 cm, calibrated: true + date/method

ekf_covariance.note: ekf_4d.yaml still uses placeholders; needs Allan static noise + straight 2 m regression.

wheel_geometry.note: Wheel diameter and lx/ly are not measured; TODO P1b.

april_tags.note: Intrinsic calibration does not place tags. /apriltag/detections stays empty until tags are printed, placed at known coordinates, and the layout is filled.

runtime_wiring_issues.current: camera.launch.py default camera_info_url is empty; its docstring points to ~/rak/data/calib/front_camera.yaml, which does not exist.

runtime_wiring_issues.fix: install slam_prep/udev/99-front-camera.rules to create /dev/front_camera, or pass video_device:=/dev/video8 explicitly
